general.openAtLoginDesc: Runs in the menu bar only, so connection requests can be approved right away.
general.openAtLoginDesc_win: Runs in the notification area only, so connection requests can be approved right away.
general.loginItemsApproval: Also allow it in System Settings › Login Items.
general.loginItemsApproval_win: Also turn it on in Settings › Apps › Startup.
general.connectionRequestsDesc: Always on, as they need your approval
general.agentQuestionsDesc: Expire after 30 minutes if no one answers
general.menuBadge: Show a dot on the icon when something needs you

update.title: Updates
update.autoDownloadDesc: Once downloaded, they install when Hermesh quits or restarts

account.removeDeviceMessage: This device will lose approval permissions immediately, and its machine will be removed too. Any machines and personal agents it approved will be re-signed by this Mac and continue working (requires Touch ID).
account.removeDeviceMessage_win: This device will lose approval permissions immediately, and its machine will be removed too. Any machines and personal agents it approved will be re-signed by this PC and continue working (requires Windows Hello).
account.signOutRemovedMessage: This Mac is no longer in your Hermesh account and can’t approve requests. After signing out, you can set it up again or rejoin your account.
account.signOutRemovedMessage_win: This PC is no longer in your Hermesh account and can’t approve requests. After signing out, you can set it up again or rejoin your account.
account.signOutFirstMessage: This device is still one of your trusted devices. First, remove it from another trusted device under Settings › Account & Devices so its approval rights are revoked and its machine disconnects. Then sign out here.
account.elevatesSilently: On this PC, User Account Control is off or set to Never notify, allowing any program to gain administrator privileges without asking and approve requests on your behalf.
account.devicesNote: Every trusted device can approve connection requests. If a device is lost, remove it from another trusted device.
account.consoleDesc: View machines and access in any browser, or revoke access in an emergency
account.machineOnlyNote: This Mac is an execution machine in your account: it runs agent tasks and is configured here, but it cannot approve requests or see your other machines. Use a trusted device to approve requests.
account.machineOnlyNote_win: This PC is an execution machine in your account: it runs agent tasks and is configured here, but it cannot approve requests or see your other machines. Use a trusted device to approve requests.

grants.note: Access controls which projects, machines, and coding agents an agent can use, and for how long.
grants.disconnectMessage: It will lose access immediately. Any running sessions will be interrupted, while session history is preserved. Reconnect it if you want to use it again.
grants.disconnectedOffline: Disconnected “{{name}}”; {{machines}} offline, will take effect once back online
grants.allMachinesLater: All machines (including ones that join later)
grants.renameMessage: Shown here and on your other devices. Other agents only see the name.
grants.iconAutoHint: Matches its name or where it signs in (for example, a connection from cursor.com appears as Cursor).
grants.iconBad: Couldn’t read that image. Try a PNG or JPEG.

machines.deviceNote: This machine is your trusted device “{{name}}”. To remove it, go to <go>Account & Devices</go>.
machines.shareDesc: Hermesh runs them from the command line just as you do, without reading API keys or tokens. Turning this off stops active sessions here; turning it on requires Touch ID.
machines.shareDesc_win: Hermesh runs them from the command line just as you do, without reading API keys or tokens. Turning this off stops active sessions here; turning it on requires Windows Hello.
machines.renameMessage: Agents refer to projects as “machine/project”, so renaming updates how they address this machine. Use only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).
machines.removeMessage: This machine will disconnect immediately and any running sessions will stop. It will need to pair again to rejoin.
machines.offlineAgents: Machine is offline; agents will appear once it reconnects

wake.title: Wake on New Messages
wake.note: Bots like Grok Bot aren’t always online. Once set up, Hermesh wakes the bot whenever a session it started finishes or another agent messages it.
